summary.name: Sora2 Hub
summary.one_liner: Sora2 Hub is a web platform that aggregates multiple third-party AI video and image models (including Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling, Runway, and GPT-4o Image) in one workspace for text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation.
use_cases: generate short social media videos from text prompts
test multiple AI video models before subscribing
integrate AI video generation into an app via API
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform that bundles many third-party AI models for video, image, and music generation into one workspace. Supported workflows are text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image, plus image editing. Videos are described as up to 1080P at 24-30fps, 5-25 seconds long, in aspect ratios such as 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1. Images are described as up to 4K with Nano Banana Pro. Users buy credits or subscribe to monthly plans, and the page says a free sandbox lets new users try models. The page also mentions API integration with documentation.
notable: Aggregates many third-party models (Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling, Runway, Nano Banana Pro, GPT-4o Image, Flux) under one credit system
Free sandbox to test models before buying a plan
Claims watermark-free output for paid users and 14-day file retention
caveats: Paid plans start at US$7.99/mo; free tier content is for personal use only and commercial rights require a paid plan
Generated files are deleted from servers after 14 days
Generation time varies from about 2 minutes to 20 minutes depending on model and quality; the page's marketing and testimonials are not independently verified
